F.user: Give me one tip for my photos.
F.text:
For photos, use these tips:
1. Keep your camera pointed and sharp (no blur). This will help you capture more detail without using unnecessary lenses or cropping.
2. Use a wide angle lens to make the subject appear larger than it really is.
3. Experiment with different compositions by moving around the frame.

FK.user: Give me one tip for my photos.
FK.text: Tip: Use a basic composition. You can start by using a mix of white, black and grey (or any color you prefer). Try to include at least 2-3 elements that complement each other. This will help balance out the overall look. For example, use a light brown or black background to create contrast with the dark blue sky and friend's outfit.
